Trains to Cambridge

This is the way I would go to the two big Air Shows if you’re not driving. Trains run to Cambridge from London King’s Cross, St Pancras and Liverpool Street, about every 30 minutes from each, then the free Air Show shuttle takes you from stand 5 at the Station Place bus interchange, right outside the station, to IWM Duxford in about 30 minutes. I would aim to be at Cambridge by about 09:00.
